items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'his daughters -- Julie and ... Cheryl' in the context of discussing another musician's family (implied to be Louis Armstrong or similar, given 'Louie helped him'). The interviewee (Barney Bigard) does not respond with any personal connection to Julie.

ctx.x: -- and his daughters -- Julie and -- I can't think of the other girl's name -- Cheryl, Julie and
Cheryl. And then he had a son, Howard, who sang under the name of Dave Howard, and Louie helped him, too.
